versions.subject: rules/windows/sysmon/sysmon_powershell_DLL_execution.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\rundll32.exe'
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    Description:
        - '*Windows-Hostprozess (Rundll32)*'
selection3:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine:
        - '*Default.GetString*'
        - '*FromBase64String*'                     
condition: selection1 or selection2 and 1 of selection3
versions.spl: (EventID=1 Image="*\\rundll32.exe") OR (EventID=1 Description="*Windows-Hostprozess (Rundll32)*" EventID=1 CommandLine IN ("*Default.GetString*", "*FromBase64String*"))
